short_desc: National Board of Examination (NBE)has released theExam City Detailson itsofficial websitefor the recruitment ofGroup A, B & C Various posts.Theexamwill be conducted on05 – 06 September 2026.and thelast dateto submit the application form was31 July 2026.Candidates can also check theirExam City Detailsby using theirEnrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birthby logging into theportal. The direct linkis provided below.(NBE Advt: A-12011/3/2025-Estb)
tables: Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary (10+2) or equivalent. They should possess a shorthand speed of 80 words per minute and a typing speed of 30 words per minute. Candidates must also qualify the General English, Shorthand, and Computer Typing tests conducted by the Board. Preference will be given to candidates with 2 years of experience as a Stenographer in a Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Body and proficiency in word processing on computers.

Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary (10+2) from a board or university recognized by the Central/State Government, Union Territory Administration, or educational authority. They should be proficient in computer operations and basic software packages, including Windows, Network Operating Systems, and LAN Architecture. Candidates must also qualify the examination prescribed by NBEMS.

Candidates must possess a recognized postgraduate medical qualification in the relevant specialty as per the Medical Council Act, 1956. Preference will be given to candidates having training in Medical Education Technology and knowledge of modern assessment techniques, including preparation of MCQs/MEQs and evaluation of candidate performance.

Candidates must have a B.Tech./B.E., BCA, DOEACC ‘B’ Level or ‘C’ Level certification, or a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics with specialization in Computers, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution/university.

Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce or a Bachelor’s degree with Mathematics or Statistics as a subject from a recognized university. Candidates must also qualify the examination prescribed by NBEMS. Preference will be given to candidates having 3 years of experience in maintaining accounts and records with knowledge of computer-based accounting in a Government or similar institution.
How To Check & Download NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Exam City Details 2026

Visit the official NBEMS website . Go to the Recruitment / Examination section. Find the Group A, B & C Various Posts 2026 exam city intimation link. Click on the Exam City Details / City Intimation Slip link. Enter your Application Number, Date of Birth, Password, or other required login details . Click on the Login / Submit button. Your NBEMS Group A, B & C Exam City Details 2026 will appear on the screen. Check your allotted exam city, exam date, shift, and other details carefully. Download and save the Exam City Intimation Slip for future reference. Download the Admit Card separately when it is released.

Post Date: August 18, 2026

National Board of Examination (NBE) has released the Exam City Details on its official website for the recruitment of Group A, B & C Various posts. The exam will be conducted on 05 – 06 September 2026. and the last date to submit the application form was 31 July 2026. Candidates can also check their Exam City Details by using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below. (NBE Advt: A-12011/3/2025-Estb)

Stenographer
  • Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary (10+2) or equivalent. They should possess a shorthand speed of 80 words per minute and a typing speed of 30 words per minute. Candidates must also qualify the General English, Shorthand, and Computer Typing tests conducted by the Board. Preference will be given to candidates with 2 years of experience as a Stenographer in a Government/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Body and proficiency in word processing on computers.
Junior Assistant
  • Candidates must have passed Senior Secondary (10+2) from a board or university recognized by the Central/State Government, Union Territory Administration, or educational authority. They should be proficient in computer operations and basic software packages, including Windows, Network Operating Systems, and LAN Architecture. Candidates must also qualify the examination prescribed by NBEMS.
Deputy Director (Medical)
  • Candidates must possess a recognized postgraduate medical qualification in the relevant specialty as per the Medical Council Act, 1956. Preference will be given to candidates having training in Medical Education Technology and knowledge of modern assessment techniques, including preparation of MCQs/MEQs and evaluation of candidate performance.
Junior Programmer
  • Candidates must have a B.Tech./B.E., BCA, DOEACC ‘B’ Level or ‘C’ Level certification, or a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Electronics with specialization in Computers, or an equivalent qualification from a recognized institution/university.
Junior Accountant
  • Candidates must have a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce or a Bachelor’s degree with Mathematics or Statistics as a subject from a recognized university. Candidates must also qualify the examination prescribed by NBEMS. Preference will be given to candidates having 3 years of experience in maintaining accounts and records with knowledge of computer-based accounting in a Government or similar institution.

 

 How To Check & Download NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Exam City Details 2026 
  • Visit the official NBEMS website.
  • Go to the Recruitment / Examination section.
  • Find the Group A, B & C Various Posts 2026 exam city intimation link.
  • Click on the Exam City Details / City Intimation Slip link.
  • Enter your Application Number, Date of Birth, Password, or other required login details.
  • Click on the Login / Submit button.
  • Your NBEMS Group A, B & C Exam City Details 2026 will appear on the screen.
  • Check your allotted exam city, exam date, shift, and other details carefully.
  • Download and save the Exam City Intimation Slip for future reference.
  • Download the Admit Card separately when it is released.
